title: kith-jmap: Session.is_read_only hardcoded false for peers — should be true
description: In build_session(), the Account struct is constructed with is_read_only: false regardless of the caller's role. A Peer-role caller should have is_read_only: true because peers can only call Peer/deliver and Peer/receipt — they cannot modify any owner-side state. RFC 8620 §2 says is_read_only=false signals that the account accepts writes. A peer-role session returning is_read_only=false is misleading: a JMAP client that respects this flag would believe it can perform set operations. The fix is: is_read_only: role == Role::Peer.
